autoLabels.title: Auto-labels
autoLabels.description: Label conversations by topic automatically. When a customer message matches a rule, its label is added to the conversation — the same label agents apply by hand, so filters, reports and label automations all see it.
autoLabels.empty: No rules yet. Add one to start labeling conversations automatically.

autoLabels.testPlaceholder: Type a customer message to see which rules match
autoLabels.testNoMatch: No keyword rule matches this message.
autoLabels.aiToggle: Also use AI for messages no keyword matches
autoLabels.aiHint: Uses your AI key (AI Agents) to pick a label from the descriptions above — only when no keyword matched and the conversation has no label yet, so it runs about once per conversation. Off by default.
autoLabels.aiNotConfigured: AI isn’t set up or is switched off in AI Agents, so this has no effect yet.
autoLabels.dialogDesc: Match by keywords, by a description for AI, or both.
autoLabels.keywordsHint: One per line or comma-separated · {count} added
autoLabels.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Payment problems, refunds, and invoice questions
autoLabels.descriptionHint: Optional. Only used when the AI option above is on.
autoLabels.needSignal: Add at least one keyword or a description.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys authenticate the public REST API (<apiCode>/api/v1</apiCode>) so you can build your own automations. Send them as <headerCode>Authorization: Bearer <key></headerCode>.
apiKeys.createOneHint: Click <bold>New API key</bold> to create one.
apiKeys.askAdminHint: Ask an admin to create one.
apiKeys.scopesHint: A key with no scopes can still call GET /api/v1/me to verify it works.

apiKeys.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
apiKeys.newKeyDesc: Name it after the integration that will use it, and grant only the scopes it needs.

deals.title: Deals & currency
deals.description: The currency used for new deals and for pipeline and dashboard totals.
deals.defaultCurrencyDesc: New deals default to this currency, and pipeline and dashboard totals are shown in it. Existing deals keep the currency they were saved with.
deals.adminOnlyHint: Only account admins can change the default currency.
deals.currenciesDesc: The currencies offered when creating a deal. Add the ones you trade in and remove the rest. Use a 3-letter ISO code such as MYR.
deals.cannotRemoveDefault: The default currency can’t be removed — choose another default first.
deals.cannotRemoveLast: At least one currency is required.
deals.removeNote: Removing a currency doesn’t change existing deals — they keep the currency they were saved with.

errors.duplicate: That currency is already in the list.

responseTime.title: Response time
responseTime.description: How long agents have to reply to a customer before the Inbox flags it as waiting.
responseTime.targetDesc: Conversations get an aging indicator once a customer's message has gone unanswered longer than this.
responseTime.invalidMinutes: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
responseTime.adminOnlyHint: Only account admins can change the response target.
responseTime.saveFailed: Failed to save the response target

aiConfig.title: Agent setup
aiConfig.description: Bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic key. wacrm calls the provider directly with your key — no per-seat AI fees, and your data stays yours. This powers AI-drafted replies in the inbox, the auto-reply bot, and the Playground.
aiConfig.adminOnlyConfig: Only admins and owners can change the AI configuration.
aiConfig.encryptionNotice: Your key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again after saving.
aiConfig.embeddingsHint: An OpenAI key used only to embed your knowledge base (text-embedding-3-small){sameKeyText}. Leave blank to use keyword search instead. Clear it to turn semantic search off.
aiConfig.sameKeyText: — can be the same key as above
aiConfig.behaviourDesc: Tell the assistant about your business — products, tone, what it may and may not promise. This context feeds both drafts and auto-replies.
aiConfig.promptPlaceholder: e.g. We are Acme, a coffee-equipment store. Be warm and concise. Never quote prices or delivery dates — hand off to a human for those.
aiConfig.enableAssistantDesc: Master switch. Turns on the “Draft with AI” button in the inbox.
aiConfig.autoReplyDesc: The bot answers new inbound messages automatically (only when no flow handles them and no agent is assigned). Hands off to a human when it can’t help.
aiConfig.maxAutoRepliesDesc: After this many bot replies in one thread, the bot goes quiet.
aiConfig.handoffToDesc: When the bot can’t help — or hits the reply cap — it pauses and routes the chat here, with a short note on what happened.
aiConfig.handoffQueue: Unassigned queue (any agent can pick it up)
aiConfig.regionHint: Kimi keys only work in the region they were created in. A mismatch looks like an invalid key.
